control: TLS 1.3 mutual authentication and exact peer certificate pin; uint32 BE canonical JSON <=65536 bytes; unchanged eight methods

readiness.lifetime: private 0600 exclusive-create, fsync before serving, refuse existing record; endpoint launcher supplies this exact boot ID to its pinned consumer

bind_context.core_hash: bytes/sha256 cover canonical JSON of exactly context_id, context_generation, originals; originals are complete native Headers, including the invoking original
bind_context.chunk_semantics: each bind_context frame uses manifest containing the chunk descriptor; bytes/hash fixed on first chunk, offset exactly accepted length, standard base64 <=32768 decoded bytes recommended; no truncation/replacement/path/URL; canonical full core verified before binding

open_relay.http: production URL is HTTPS; handle is only a turn bearer
open_relay.stdio: actual pinned CLI executes --turn-relay <handle>; handle is unpadded base64url of a closed endpoint/token JSON ticket <=512 characters; contains no Bot/control credential; endpoint launcher verifies absolute executable/hash
open_relay.relay_executable: private config may name the pinned CLI; empty selects this executable; absolute regular non-writable executable required
open_relay.bearer_domain: 64 lowercase hex characters; ordinary bf_/app_/uk_ credentials are rejected by the relay ticket parser

current_native_header_join: CLI only joins a complete Header to the same exact native observation and delivery reference already resolved by this host; then fresh contributor facts/Stage1 are required
history_prerequisite: Header references and delivery references are distinct opaque domains. Unseen history Headers need a recognized native reference bridge/current-access port; no token alias is guessed. Actual native producer remains missing.
verification: exact pinned endpoint control source exercised over mTLS with standard fixture-only parameter-property lowering for Node strip mode, then actual CLI --turn-relay process and real synthetic TLS business receiver; not native/provider/OS acceptance
rpc_identity: JSON-RPC IDs only correlate replies; equal parameters and reused IDs may be legitimate new logical calls. Each BeginCall mints a private call ID and each prepared physical attempt is one-use. Native delivery replay is separately fenced; no argument-based idempotency is invented.
